panels.general_description: Sanger sequencing chromatograms of father, mother and child for two MYBPC3 variants with colored arrows at the variant positions.
panels.detailed_description: Two stacked sets of three Sanger chromatograms, each row labelled with text "I-1 Father", "I-2 Mother" and "II-1 Child". The upper set has a green title "MYBPC3(NM_000256.3):c.2905+1G>A; Intron 27" with boxes labelled "Intron 27" and "Exon 27" above colored base-call letters; a green arrow sits under one peak in each row. At the arrowed position the father trace shows a small overlapping blue and red peak, the mother trace shows a single blue peak, and the child trace shows a small overlapping blue and red peak. The lower set has a red title "MYBPC3(NM_000256.3):c.836del(p.Gly279Valfs*21);exon 8" with colored base-call letters and a red arrow under one peak in each row. At and after the arrowed position the father trace shows single peaks, while the mother and child traces show overlapping peaks of several colors after the arrow. The bold letter m is printed above the upper title.
